label: early original-phase input of q/k/y/2/u/w (boosted after x/t/z/j/m prefix)
explanation: Fires almost entirely during the original (input) phase (95% of mass), peaking at t=1-4 and fading by t=6+; it is near-silent at t=0, on the <DEL> step and in the copy phase. It prefers certain current inputs (q strongest, then k, y, 2, u, w; weaker 0, b, n, h, g, e), mostly on their first occurrence. The largest activations come when such a token follows an early prefix of x/t/z/j/m (e.g. x t t [k], x x n [q]); first_tok=x has the highest rate. Predicate (t=1-5, input in {q,k,y,2,u,w}) gets dev P=0.37 R=0.52 mass recall 0.62. Activity is diffuse: many weaker activations land on other early tokens after an x/t/z/j/m prefix, and many in-set tokens give no activation, so this is only a partial description of a distributed token-by-context code.
